# AMS (Algorithms & Mathematics Society)

> AMS is an Indian organization that runs national contests in quantitative
> finance and competitive programming, and builds Access, a proctored
> assessment platform that turns contest performance into verified hiring
> signal. Official site: https://amshq.in. Not affiliated with the American
> Mathematical Society (ams.org) or other organizations sharing the acronym.

Key facts:

- AMS has conducted 2 competitions to date. Its talent pool is 5,000+
  students drawn from 30+ institutions across India.
- Derive is the AMS quant contest: probability, markets, and mathematical
  reasoning. The 2026 edition had 2,500+ participants, 150 advanced to
  Round 2, 50 qualified for the finals, and 33 finalists competed offline
  at IIT Bombay in July 2026.
- Jane Street was the Apex Partner of Derive '26; QRT was the Convergence
  Partner of the finals.
- Ascent is the AMS systems contest (C++, optimization, performance
  engineering), the winter edition of the circuit. Registration is open and
  free, closing 20 October 2026, at https://ascent.amshq.in. Round 1 is on
  24 October 2026, Round 2 on 6 December, and the finals in Mumbai in
  December.
- Access is the AMS assessment platform: a native desktop lockdown app with
  seven readiness checks, audited proctoring, and scoring benchmarked against
  the AMS contest population. Product site: https://amsaccess.com.
- Contests are open to students at Indian institutions; eligibility details
  live at https://amsderive.in.
- Firms sponsor contests or run private benchmarked assessments; contact via
  https://amshq.in/access.

- [Access](https://amshq.in/access): the proctored assessment platform
